top_examples.hook: My brother accused me of stealing Mom's wedding ring. She had sold it herself, and she let him blame me through the whole dinner.
top_examples.premise: A brother accuses his sister of stealing their mother's wedding ring while their mother conceals that she sold it to help the sister leave her marriage.
top_examples.title: Mom Hid Her Hand Through the Whole Dinner

top_examples.hook: The mechanic wouldn't return my car without my husband's permission. The car was mine, and my husband was using the delay to make me miss a job interview.
top_examples.premise: A mechanic refuses to return a woman's repaired car without her husband's permission because her husband wants her to miss an interview for a job away from home.
top_examples.title: The Mechanic Was Waiting for My Husband

top_examples.hook: The storage manager bought my unit at his own auction. I found my dining table in his house listing while automatic payments were still leaving my account.
top_examples.premise: A storage manager deliberately misapplies a customer's payments, auctions her unit through a relative, and uses her belongings to furnish his rental house.
top_examples.title: The Storage Manager Bought My Unit at His Auction

top_examples.hook: The school accused my daughter of copying her own science project. A sponsor unveiled her flood sensor at assembly, then the principal called her a plagiarist when she said she built it.
top_examples.premise: A school sells a student's science-fair invention to a corporate sponsor and then accuses the student of plagiarism when she claims the project is hers.
top_examples.title: The School Accused My Daughter of Copying Herself

top_examples.hook: My boss put my salary on the office scoreboard. Then he announced whoever closed the biggest deal by Friday would take home the money I had already earned.
top_examples.premise: A company withholds an employee's earned salary and publicly offers the exact amount as a sales prize for her coworkers.
top_examples.title: My Salary Became the Office Sales Prize
